cv.name: Yasmin Mansouri
cv.headline: Student Teacher of English | Secondary education (havo/vmbo)
cv.summary: Final-year student in English teacher education with a long placement at a secondary school in Leidsche Rijn. I enjoy teaching mixed-ability classes and using drama and short projects to get students speaking.

experience.title: Student Teacher English (LIO placement)
bullets: Teach four first- and second-year classes (havo and vmbo-t) under supervision
Plan lessons and assessments aligned with the school's curriculum and CEFR levels
Developed a speaking project with short role plays that the department adopted for year 2
Take part in parent evenings and mentor meetings

experience.title: Homework Support Tutor (part-time)
bullets: Supported small groups of secondary students with English, planning and exam preparation

education.degree: Bachelor of Education – English Teacher (second degree)
education.school: HU University of Applied Sciences Utrecht

extra_sections: Volunteer: weekly language café for newcomers at the Utrecht public library
